DOES YOUR DEFINITION OF SUCCESS MEAN EMPOWERING OTHERS?

Then you should consider joining Jobber! We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Customer Onboarding to join our Success Team.

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers.

THE TEAM

Our Customer Success team works together with other teams and stakeholders to bring our company values to life for our customers. By being humble, supportive, and truly giving a sh*t, the team ensures that our customers are successful in Jobber. This team thrives on meaningful and impactful communication with one another and with our customers and plays a significant role in the lives of entrepreneurs and business owners who utilize Jobber.

Our Onboarding team is a critical part of the customer journey, responsible for activation, retention, and depth of adoption. Onboarding ensures that Service Providers - from fast-growing home service businesses to our largest and most complex accounts - get a high-touch onboarding experience that removes friction from day one. The team partners closely with Sales, Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success to align on launches, resolve blockers, and continuously strengthen the customer experience.

The role:

Reporting to the Director, Customer Onboarding, the Senior Manager, Customer Onboarding will lead the Onboarding Specialists and Managers who serve our largest, most complex and strategic accounts. This is a true ownership role: you are accountable for the service delivery, execution, and results of the Onboarding Managers and Specialists in your service model — and for the experience of every customer in your portfolio.

We're looking for a tenured leader who has done this before. Someone who builds trust across the business quickly, goes deep enough on our product to be credible in the room with our biggest customers, communicates like an executive, and defaults to action when things are ambiguous (and they will be — we move fast!).

The Senior Manager, Customer Onboarding will:

 - Own the service delivery and execution of your portfolio. You are accountable for the performance of the Onboarding Managers and Specialists in your segment, and for the experience and outcomes of every customer in it. When something is off track, you drive it to resolution.

 - Manage and develop a team of Onboarding Managers and Onboarding Specialists — and build coaches, not just a team. Your Managers are coaches first: you’ll develop their coaching craft, hold the standard on QA and coaching cadences, and treat the performance of every IC in your org as a reflection of the leadership environment above them. You optimize results through effective performance management — 1:1’s, “real-time” coaching, documented career plans, feedback that flows both ways, and any other creative programs you think will be impactful. In order to be successful, our employees need to clearly understand how to get there — and when someone isn’t meeting the bar, you address it early and with care. Underperformance never lingers on your team. You build systems and standards that hold without you in the room.

 - Own it end-to-end, and default to action. Leaders who thrive here pressure-test ideas, then commit fully, champion them with their team, and see them through when the work gets messy. You don’t wait for context to find you - you go get it. When you’re unclear, blocked, or unaligned, you raise it early and directly, make the call with the information you have, and close your own loops.

 - Bring solutions, not status. You show up to leadership conversations with the problem framed, the data decision-ready, and a recommendation on the table. You stand behind your numbers - and if the data isn't ready to act on, you say so and own getting it there.

 - Know the business. You understand how your portfolio’s performance connects to the broader business, you proactively spot opportunities and risks before they show up in a dashboard - and you bring leadership a recommended solution, then mobilize your team to execute on it

 - Go deep on the product. Our biggest customers run complex operations, and their onboarding gets technical. You'll become an expert in Jobber - enough to guide tough conversations about workflows, integrations, data, and rollout plans with confidence and credibility, supporting the team during high impact projects as needed.

 - Drive execution excellence through tooling - including AI. You’ll optimize Salesforce and our platform stack, and lead your team’s adoption of AI-enabled workflows: knowing when to trust them, when to verify, and how to feed what your team learns back into the system.

 - Bring executive presence. You’ll represent your portfolio and service model with Jobber’s leadership, and represent Jobber with the senior stakeholders at our largest customers - communicating with clarity and composure, especially when things aren't going as expected.

 - Build strong cross-functional relationships across Sales, Support, Product, Marketing, Analytics, Enablement and Partnerships, so your team can provide informed, proactive support in accordance with all campaigns, product launches and customer initiatives.

 - Recruit, onboard and ramp new hires quickly - and feed what’s working back to Enablement so training gets better for everyone.”

 - Become an ambassador of our culture by being humble, supportive, and someone who truly gives a shit!

TO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU'LL NEED:

 - 5+ years in post-sale SaaS customer success or onboarding, including several years leading teams - and you understand the difference between managing a team and building leaders who run their own. Experience managing managers is strongly preferred.

 - Hands-on experience managing Key/Large Account think enterprise-grade or multi-location customers, complex rollouts, and multiple senior stakeholders on both sides of the table.

 - A track record of true end-to-end ownership: you've been accountable for the outcomes of a portfolio, not just the activities of a team.

 - Strong business acumen for your scope: you’re fluent in the metrics that drive your service model, you understand how your team’s performance ladders up to the business, and when you spot an opportunity you come to leadership with a recommended solution - not just the problem.

 - Next level communication and relationship building abilities. We move fast, which means you'll need to build a high degree of trust with peers and key stakeholders — and the executive presence to articulate strategic ideas with leadership and deliver on high-level concepts.

 - A strong understanding of Salesforce, spreadsheets, and any other methodology of getting the data you need - you build your own view of performance rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

 - To be agile and adaptable in a very fast-paced environment. We're growing fast and things are changing every day - what worked yesterday might not anymore. You need to be invigorated by this type of environment, and be excited by a new challenge.

 - An incredible passion for our customer and a connection to our purpose — to help small and commercial businesses be more successful.

This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You’ll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

 Gérer les projets et leurs échéanciers, coordonner les parties prenantes et assurer leur clôture.

 Suivre les impacts des changements d’ingénierie, alertes critiques et non-conformités.

 Baccalauréat, idéalement en génie ou en gestion des opérations
